body.en: Use “Piston engines” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. Model Diesel Mixer Integrated. Engine 4108 / 66–75 kW. Output 25 m³/h. Maximum outlet pressure 23 MPa. Hopper 0.4 m³. Stone capacity, labelled horizontal / vertical, 100 / 300 m. 13 mm stone 60 / 180 m. 24 mm stone 40 / 120 m. Size 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. Weight 4200 kg. Series note: 30 model with 400 mixer. 40/50 model with 500 mixer. The 100 / 300 m cell is distance, not a pipe DN. Integrated Mixer Pump prints delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm, main motor 45 kW / mixer 14 kW, output 21 m³/h and pressure 23 MPa. Sharing a 400/500 mixer note does not copy the pipe cell. Mixing seals φ65 and φ80, and the generation kits, do not name either mixer. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
